verdicts.reason: Three parts of the rule contradict PCGen and one contradicts the formula lane. (1) Typed VAR stacking is ignored: getTotalBonusTo("VAR", name) runs every VAR addend through the same fold as any bonus (BonusManager.java:640-700, pinned PCGen 7f818006 (~/workspace/repos/pcgen, read-only)): same-TYPE addends whose type is not in miscinfo.lst:17 BONUSSTACKS take the MAX, .STACK sums, .REPLACE is max(plain+stack, replace) (:475-489). Corpus-wide 4,954 VAR addends carry TYPE=Base, 373 TYPE=Resistance, 992 TYPE=Domain, and 426 names have >=2 addends sharing one non-Boolean type (AC_Natural_Armor 1,385 Base, ColdResistanceBonus 89 Resistance). Real record pair: bestiary_2:monster:athach (b2_races.lst:108) `BONUS:VAR|ColdResistanceBonus|10|TYPE=Resistance` under bestiary_4:template:Shadow Creature (b4_templates.lst:164) `BONUS:VAR|ColdResistanceBonus|15|TYPE=Resistance|PREHD:MIN=11` -> PCGen 15, rule 2's DEFINE-plus-every-addend sum prints 25; werebear_abilities (b2_templates.lst:24) `AC_Natural_Armor|2|TYPE=Base` on athach's `15|TYPE=Base` -> PCGen 15, rule 17. bonus_stack_reader.rs::evaluate_stack has no TYPE handling (grep). (2) Corpus-wide inlining sums addends from records the character does not hold; PCGen's active-bonus map holds only held objects' bonuses (PlayerCharacter.java:2090-2140, getTotalBonusTo). BloodlineLVL has 5 corpus setters (bloodline_tracker, bloodline_development, eldritch_scion bloodline, draconic_bloodline-2, mythic_bloodline) plus Robe of Arcane Heritage (apg_equip_magic_items.lst:227) in PCGen; a sorcerer holds one. Same defect the formula lane names in row 28. (3) '/ -> Div (floors); floor(x) -> x' is not PCGen: JEP division is real-valued and truncation happens once at consumption (.intValue(); old parser VariableProcessor.java:378-420 `total /= valFloat`). 68 of 3,783 BONUS formulas containing a division (corpus-wide, own parse) feed an unfloored quotient into a multiplication: apg_abilities_class.lst:2118 Hawkeye `5+(5*((FighterLVL-2)/4))` PCGen F20 = 27 (27.5 truncated), rule = 25; ag eyes_of_the_storm `5+(5*(DruidLVL/4))`; acg beastmorph `BeastmorphProgression/2*15`. (4) The DEFINE-existence gate is silently dropped: when no HELD object DEFINEs the name PCGen sets includeBonus=false and discards every BONUS:VAR into it (PlayerCharacter.java:2124-2136); the rule keeps them. (5) V1 'DEFINEd nowhere in the corpus -> refuse per name' is wrong for most of its population: see cross_family_conflicts[1]. Counts that do reproduce: 27,331 instances, 10,211 records, 6,699 non-DONE units (row says 6,708) of 23,315 non-DONE units (completion_atlas._bucket_of over docs/work-inventory.json at HEAD); records joined by (book, source basename, source line) with (book, kind, key) fallback over 48,706 data/corpus/**/*.json records carrying data.raw_tokens (_parity/ and LICENSE.json excluded).

cross_family_conflicts.issue: The bonus lane inlines DEFINE base + every corpus addend for a name; the formula lane says inline over-counts and recommends a contribution table summed over HELD rules. PCGen: the value of a variable is the DEFINE seed of held objects plus getTotalBonusTo("VAR", name) over the character's ACTIVE bonus map, which holds only bonuses of objects the character holds (PlayerCharacter.java:2090-2140); so unheld setters never contribute. BloodlineLVL: 5 corpus setters + Robe of Arcane Heritage (apg_equip_magic_items.lst:227); a sorcerer holds Bloodline Tracker (cr_abilities_class.lst:1705, `BONUS:VAR|BloodlineLVL|SorcererLVL|TYPE=Base`) only. Both lanes miss a second PCGen fact: VAR contributions are TYPED and fold by BonusManager.java:640-700 (same non-BONUSSTACKS type -> max), e.g. athach (b2_races.lst:108) `ColdResistanceBonus|10|TYPE=Resistance` + Shadow Creature (b4_templates.lst:164) `15|TYPE=Resistance` -> PCGen 15, either lane's plain sum 25.
cross_family_conflicts.recommendation: Ruling: formula row 28 form B. Expr::Var(VarId) + data/sheet_rules/_vars/<id>.json listing {rule_id, expr, bonus_type}; the live evaluator sums held contributions through the S1 BONUSSTACKS fold (untyped/Dodge/Racial/Circumstance/Defense/NotRanged/NotFlatFooted sum; other same-type max; .STACK sum; .REPLACE = max(plain+stack, replace); negatives always add) and yields 0 when no held rule DEFINEs the name (PlayerCharacter.java:2124-2136 includeBonus=false). Held-ness comes from the prereq lane's held-set fixpoint, which needs class LEVEL grants (prereq.md 4.2) -- that ruling now blocks this family's cross-record rows too.

cross_family_conflicts.issue: Both sets are computed case-sensitively, and the bonus lane's set is not 'DEFINEd nowhere'. PCGen variable keys are case-insensitive (VariableKey.java:23,36,123 CaseInsensitiveMap; BonusManager.java:99,216 toUpperCase). Own census of identifiers in BONUS formulas with no corpus DEFINE (219 names after dropping 8 tokenizer artefacts, 629 non-DONE units of 23,315): (a) 130 names / 778 instances / 434 non-DONE units are DEFINEd in pinned PCGen data on rows the corpus never ingested (VitalistLVL and 8 more ultimate_psionics classes in up_classes.lst, Caster_Level_Bonus in ce_abilities.lst, BoonCompanionBonus_AnimalCompanion in sos_abilities.lst, CompanionHD/PhantomMasterLevel in companion mods, adventurers_guide prestige levels in ag_classes.lst) -- PCGen does NOT print 0 for these, so Const(0) is wrong and refuse-per-name mislabels an ingest remainder; (b) 21 names / 76 instances / 67 non-DONE units are case variants of a DEFINEd name (FighterLvl, HellknightLvl, MONKLVL, MASTERLEVEL) that PCGen resolves -- both lanes' 'undefined' verdicts are wrong for them; (c) 68 names / 495 instances / 134 non-DONE units are DEFINEd nowhere in corpus or PCGen (BloodlinePower{1,3,9,15,20}LVLBonus, BloodlinePower1TimesBonus, EldrtichHeritage*, Bloodrager_CF_*, FavoredTerrainBase) -- for these PCGen evaluates the term to 0 (VariableProcessor.java:532-560 lookupVariable returns null; :378-420 NumberFormatException -> 'just zero'; PlayerCharacter.java:2124-2136 drops BONUS:VAR contributions), so Const(0) plus a defect list matches the oracle. The formula lane's 618 counts every formula position; this family's share is (c).
cross_family_conflicts.recommendation: Ruling: three sets, each per name. (a) ingest remainder per file (formula row 29's mechanism), not a refusal and not 0; (b) resolve case-insensitively in the converter's variable index; (c) Const(0) with data/sheet_rules/_defects/undefined-variables.json, plus a converter-side alias table for obvious typos of a DEFINEd sibling (HellknightLvl -> HellknightLVL is set (b), but EldrtichHeritage* has no sibling and stays 0). Print-what-the-player-writes is not met for (c) by either lane; the defect list is the honest surface.

cross_family_conflicts.issue: The two lanes agree with each other and both diverge from PCGen: JEP evaluates `/` as real division and only the consumer truncates (VariableProcessor.java:378-420; .intValue() at every consumption site). 68 of 3,783 BONUS formulas with a division feed an unfloored quotient into a multiplication (own parse, corpus-wide): Hawkeye `5+(5*((FighterLVL-2)/4))` = 27 in PCGen vs 25 under Div-floors; `TempestDruidStormSight|5+(5*(DruidLVL/4))`; `BeastmorphClimbSpeed|BeastmorphProgression/2*15`. In several the book intends the floored value, so this is a PCGen quirk the oracle will surface.
cross_family_conflicts.recommendation: Converter normalises each formula to a single top-level truncation (rational numerator over a constant denominator; formula gap G16) so parity holds, and records the 68 formulas as a named PCGen-divergence class in artifacts/epic-6-pcgen-exit/ so Epic 6 parity does not chase them one by one. Keep explicit floor()/ceil() as nodes.
